packages.name: @comchatx/cx-s3-storage
packages.description: Stores your images in your own bucket, with links for listings.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
To change a listing's main image, Amazon needs a link to the picture that anyone can open. Connect your own cloud storage to cx, and cx stores images and other files there, each with a public link a listing can use as its main image; it can also list, read, copy and delete them. Useful for keeping and sorting product images. Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2 and other S3-compatible storage all work; providers call the place a bucket.

Some things you can ask:

- Store these images in my bucket's listings folder, and give me each one's link.
- Which images are in my bucket's listings folder?
- Copy last year's images in listings to an archive folder, then delete the originals.

## Connecting your bucket

On the plugin's Settings, enter the endpoint, bucket, region, Access key ID, Secret access key and public address. Your provider's guide shows where to find each one. A key limited to one bucket keeps cx to that bucket. Your keys stay with ComChatX and are never given to cx.

## What it costs

Nothing on ComChatX. Your provider bills your own account as usual.

shipped.readme_zh:
改 listing 的主图时，亚马逊要的是一个谁都能打开的图片链接。这个插件把 cx 连到你自己的云存储，cx 把图片和其他文件存进去，每个文件都有公开链接，可以直接填作 listing 的主图；也能列出、读取、复制和删除里面的文件。适合存放和整理商品图片。Amazon S3、Cloudflare R2 等兼容 S3 的云存储都能用，服务商把存文件的地方叫「存储桶」。

你可以这样问：

- 把这几张图存进存储桶的 listings 文件夹，再告诉我每张的链接。
- 存储桶的 listings 文件夹里有哪些图片？
- 把 listings 里去年的旧图复制到 archive 文件夹，再删掉原图。

## 连接存储桶

在插件的「设置」里填写端点、存储桶、区域、Access key ID、Secret access key 和公开地址，各项的获取方法见服务商的指南。密钥只能访问一个存储桶时，cx 也只能用这一个。你的密钥保存在 ComChatX，不会交给 cx。

## 费用

ComChatX 不收费，服务商照常向你自己的账号收费。

skills.name: s3
skills.description: The seller's own S3-compatible object storage (Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi or any provider that serves the S3 API) through the S3 REST API, signed with the seller's key — list, read, write, copy and delete objects, multipart uploads, and the public address of a stored object, such as an image's URL for a listing. Use before the first call that reads or changes the seller's own bucket. Needs cx-sources; if no cx-sources skill is listed, it is not installed, and the seller installs it in Plugins.
